summary: Document unresolved native producer recovery and verify late PTY retirement

replay.detail: No projection replay or launch replay is introduced.

schema.detail: Storage stays at version 19. Correcting the authoritative schema documentation to retain its generated rollback guidance changes the documentation digest only.

rules.detail: No replicated claim or checkpoint rule changes.

compatibility.detail: Old PTY producer errors remain unresolved unless exact operation-owned retirement or producer closure is proved. No producer option or PTY pin change.

downtime.detail: No additional restart beyond the already classified ledger upgrade.

manual.detail: For a returned native producer error with START OPEN, publish ordinary stop, preserve the operation ledger and runtime records, inspect start-revocation-unverified, and escalate to Operations. An old PTY producer that never publishes has no supported command to prove closure and release the seat; deployment with that residual liveness limit requires the producer-contract decision.

recovery.detail: This operator guidance adds no separate recovery mechanism; the separately classified database and runtime-state restoration procedure applies.
